name: research-proposal-architect
description: Write, diagram, and audit Chinese science and technology proposal research sections.

interface.shortDescription: Write, diagram, and audit Chinese research proposals.
interface.longDescription: Routes Chinese science and technology proposal work across five content levels and three operations. It drafts research sections, creates backend-neutral figure specifications, checks text-figure correspondence, and hands editable figure construction to Scientific Illustrator.
defaultPrompt: 帮我判断这段申报书应写研究内容还是技术路线。
根据这段研究内容设计一张可编辑的技术路线图。
检查申报书文字与配图是否完整对应并给出校正结果。
